Definition: a pot or furnace (as if excavated)
BiblicalUsage: The furnace is the smelting pot, and Scripture makes it the picture of Egypt and of affliction. In Deuteronomy 4:20 and 1 Kings 8:51 Egypt is "the iron furnace" God brought Israel out of, in Ezekiel 22:18 Israel has become dross in the midst of the furnace, and in Isaiah 48:10 God says, "I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction."
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the furnace is the proof that affliction is not abandonment: God calls Egypt a furnace and still brings His people out of it, and He chooses His people in the furnace, not after it. The furnace did not destroy Israel, and it will not destroy me.
